$comment: What a Build may write into a restored Tracy Business site, and where each value lands. Entities are located by identity (an option name, or a page's postType+slug), never by post id. A block inside a page is located by its metadata.name -- the convention every wp-tracy-business section markup follows -- never by position. `input` names the customer input the seeder fills the slot from; a slot with NO `input` is written by the model from the customer's brief (packages/cms/tracy-seeder/src/plan-wordpress-contract.mjs), the same way a Joomla contract is filled, and keeps the quickstart's own words when the model has no fact for it. LANGUAGE: this quickstart ships 41 Polylang editions of the same site; only the entities of the language the customer chose are planned, so the other 40 keep their own words untouched.
